description: Every pin in this repository (actions in workflows and action.yml files, dev tools in uv.lock, the bunx package in .pre-commit-config.yaml, and *_VERSION workflow variables marked with a renovate comment) is bumped here. A release waits a few days before it is proposed, so a broken or compromised release is usually yanked first. No hourly limit, so a pin bump never waits behind others.

customManagers.description: Packages pre-commit hooks run through bunx

packageRules.description: An x.y.0 release waits longer than the default
